title_lines: The Company's prime objective when managing capital is to safeguard its ability to continue as a going concern in order to provide adequate
returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders and to maintain an optimal capital structure to reduce the cost of capital
In order to maintain or adjust capital structure, the company may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders, issue new shares or sell
Consistent with others in the industry, the Company monitors capital on the basis of the gcaring ratio. This ratio is calculated as debt divided
by total capital employed. Total capital employed is calculated as equity as shown in the statement of financial position plus debt.
